repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpEsWWE9Y5YtSsDgqZ

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · L1 · head `97fa2d8386f3e440910b6eb357e8d93876e2f2fd` · 2026-11-25T19:59Z

Reviewed against GitHub and the committed tree at this head, not against report 7171588755.

**Shape.** `l1-face.mjs --pr 37338` reads CLEAN: 13 items, none flagged. The PR is open, draft, and based on `main`. The first line is `Fixes #37134`, and no closing keyword sits near another card. There is no `content/docs/releases/` path and no `+0/-0` file. The size is +365/−80 over 7 files. No path is governed (`.changeset/**`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/**`, `ui/packages/i18n/src/**`), so this is Tier S. `Fixes` is right: the diff delivers all of Expected 1, 2 and 4. Expected 3 was overtaken when #36908 landed first and removed the landing door.

**Card fit and reach.** In create mode with a step, `PackageFormDialog` draws 「同时创建应用」 / "Also create an app". `useState(true)` sets it, and so does `setAlsoApp(true)` in the open effect, so it is ticked on every opening. Submitting runs `appStep = offersApp && alsoApp ? newApp : undefined`. Ticked, that is the #36748 reserve → package `POST` → app draft → publish path, unchanged. Unticked, it sends the package `POST` alone. `CreatePackageDialog` now passes `newAppStep(client, locale)`.
- At head, `git grep CreatePackageDialog` (non-test) finds two mounts, `PackagesPage.tsx:2463` and `ResourceListPage.tsx:1243`.
- Every other `PackageFormDialog` mount is `mode="edit"` or `mode="view"`: `PackagesPage.tsx:705`, `PackagesPage.tsx:1559` and `inspectors/ObjectPicker.tsx:712`.
- Outside the dialog, `ui/**` has no other package-create path.
- The console's 「新建空白应用」 doors reach the dialog through `useNewPackageDoorPath` → Setup `?new=package`.

So the default-on box reaches every create-mode door that remains.

**Premise drift.** Confirmed at head. `studio-design/PackageSwitcher.tsx` now exports only `PACKAGE_LIST_TOAST_ID`, and its header names #36501 as the commit that removed the top-bar switcher. The card's 「Studio package switcher」 call site no longer exists.

**Declarations and changeset.** I ran `readClause2Line` and `readMetadataProtocolLine` (`scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs`) on three texts:

| Text | `Clause-②` | `Metadata-protocol` |
|:--|:--|:--|
| The card's newest `Claim:` (7169203072) | declared `no`, arm null | declared `none` |
| The PR body | declared `no`, arm null | declared `none` |
| `.changeset/37134-create-package-also-app.md` | declared `no`, arm null | declared `none` |

All three read the same.

`no` is right. The three new keys go into the `studio` namespace, which is typed `Record<string, string>` and exported as `StudioCatalogue = Readonly<Record<string, string>>`. No published type gains a member, which is the card's own Expected 4 criterion. `PackageFormDialog`'s prop types are unchanged; the removed `withAppDoorWording` and `APP_DOOR_HELP_ROWS` were module-private. `@object-ui/app-shell` is `private: true`.

`none` is right: nothing a metadata author writes changes. So `patch` for `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n` is the right level.

I read the changeset sentence by sentence against the diff:
- The three doors.
- "ticked each time the dialog opens".
- The en and zh toast strings, which match `createdWithApp` byte for byte.
- The taken-identifier refusal, which matches `newApp.nameTaken` and writes nothing.
- The `appFailed` toast.
- "Unticked: only the package is created".
- "Where the dialog takes you afterwards is unchanged".
- The three key names, and "No key is removed".
- "no other props or exports change".

All hold.

**Translation keys.** `node ui/packages/i18n/scripts/released-keys-removed.mjs --tag @object-ui/i18n@18.6.0` lists 77 keys at `--ref 97fa2d83`, 77 at the merge-base `fbb62e1c` and 77 at `origin/main` `a182fbe3`. A sorted diff of head against the merge-base is empty, so this PR removes no released key. The 77 are pre-existing.

The three new keys (`engine.packages.create.alsoApp`, `alsoAppHint`, `createdWithApp`) are in both `studio` catalogues, en and zh. "All 11 packs" does not apply here. `studio` is a two-catalogue key space by ruling (#25922): every other language falls back to `en`, and its `index.ts` puts it outside the 11-pack parity suite "by construction … ⛔ must never be given" an exemption. The merged tree from `git merge-tree` against `a182fbe3`, which includes #37315's edits to the same two catalogues, has no duplicate key lines in either catalogue.

**Pins and ablations.** I ran these in a throwaway worktree at head, with the `@objectstack/*` closure built (`OS_SKIP_DTS=1`). The worktree has since been removed.
- `pnpm exec vitest run` on `PackageFormDialog.newAppStep-36748.test.tsx` and `PackagesPage.installedAppsUpdates-34722.test.tsx`: Test Files 2 passed, Tests 54 passed, exit 0. The first file has 11 cases, matching the body.
- **A5 re-run:** `CreatePackageDialog` passes `newApp={undefined}`. Result: 9 failed, 45 passed. The red cases are both "ticked on every opening" cases, the three ticked/unticked/taken cases, the wrapper source pin, and the three `PackagesPage` door cases (New Package button, `?new=package`, development face). That matches the report's 9.
- **A2 re-run:** `appStep = offersApp ? newApp : undefined`, which ignores the box. Result: 2 failed, "unticked: only the package…" and "ticked, an app name already taken…; unticked, the package goes through". That matches the report's 2.
- Both restores were checked by blob hash (`eca3c854…`, `4ff26da7…`) against the HEAD blob, with an empty `git diff HEAD`.

**Gates.** The check-runs at `97fa2d83` are 58: 45 success, 13 skipped, 0 failed, 0 pending. `l1-face` counts the 13 as expected skips, with 0 unexpected. Lint & Repo Gates and TypeScript Type Check are both `success`. Test Core is skipped by design on a ui-only head.

`git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main(a182fbe3) 97fa2d83` merges cleanly (tree `4fc1d786`). `mergeable_state` is `clean`.

**K = 10.** `landing-k.mjs --pr 37338` cannot answer: green run 45676342084 ran no Test Core shard, so it printed no `Affected-set diff base`. K is therefore read as the first-parent count from the merge-base `fbb62e1c` to `origin/main` `a182fbe3`, which is 10. The legs:
- Locale leg: since the base, `main` has added no locale pack. Every `translations/` and `locales/` change on main is a modification, not an addition.
- Label leg: this PR changes no `translations/` bundle.
- Shared-budget leg: this PR does not touch `ui/**/locales/en.ts`.

**Accepted deviations.** These are the zone's rulings in 7172708246 (2026-11-25T19:44Z):
- Q1 A: the unread `engine.studio.newApp.*` rows stay, and one retirement card follows after landing.
- Q2 A: the submit label stays "Create package" / 「创建软件包」.

Card Expected 3 was overtaken by #36908's earlier landing.

**Out of scope.** A Studio-only author who cannot open Setup → Packages still has no New Package door. That goes to #37139, as the body's Acceptance notes and 7172708246 record. `useNewPackageDoorPath` confirms this: such an author's doors lead to Studio's "All metadata", not to the dialog.

`Skills-docs:` is not owed (kind `none`, no narrowing arm). No contract review is owed. The diff touches none of the four faces: the declaration is `Clause-②: no` with no narrowing arm, there is no `packages/spec/src/**` path, and there is no governed path. `reviewFace` reports empty `hits.schema` and empty `hits.rules`.

**维护者速读.** It is accurate and follows the four-line form:
1. Who and where: Setup's 「软件包」 page and the 「新建空白应用」 doors that reach the same dialog.
2. The Studio redesign topic.
3. A taken name writes nothing, and the PR is UI-only and can be reverted.
4. 「无」.

It contains no code names, paths, commands, ruling letters or bare card numbers.

### Findings

- N1 — This diff also leaves `engine.studio.newApp.created` with no reader. Its only reader was the success toast at the base's `PackageFormDialog.tsx:690`, and head replaces it with `engine.packages.create.createdWithApp`; a grep at head finds 0 non-catalogue readers. Neither the PR body's Acceptance notes list nor the Q1 list in 7172708246 names it. The en catalogue comment is accurate ("the app-worded rows have no reader since"). Seat-side: the retirement card the zone files after landing should list `created` beside `title`, `description`, `advancedHint`, `id`, `help.*`, `nsDerived`, `exists` and `failed`. No change to this PR is needed.
- N2 — The door source pin matches `<PackageFormDialog\b[^>]*>`, which stops at the first `>`, including the one inside an arrow `=>`. It only classifies a mount by `mode="edit|view"` when `mode` comes before any arrow-function prop. At head, every mount puts `mode` first, so the pin reads correctly. This is a fragility to keep in mind if a mount is reordered, not a defect.

No must-fix, no should-fix.

- Landing: the zone lands it as Tier S. K = 10 (< 15, every leg clear), so there is no merge of `main` first. Re-read the checks and `mergeable_state` at `97fa2d83` right before arming.
